ModHarmonyMire.curse_effect: Missed notes reduce ultimate gauge by 25%
ModHarmonyMire.flavor: A harmony of fate; strike true or wilt under the curse of discord.

ModMelodicFate.flavor: An ethereal melody protects you from harm but leaves you vulnerable to physical attacks.

ModMelodicHarmony.flavor: Harmonious notes strengthen the body but weaken the spirit's resilience.

ModMelodicLabyrinth.flavor: Blessed by the melody, cursed by silence.

ModMelodicMire.description: HP +10% for each piece of sheet music found.
ModMelodicMire.curse_effect: Missed notes drain SP by 5, max 3 per turn.
ModMelodicMire.flavor: Even the sweetest tune can be twisted into a dark melody when lost in the Mire of Melody.

ModMelodicPuzzle.description: Reduces incoming damage by 10% while under rhythm timing window.
ModMelodicPuzzle.curse_effect: Missed rhythm notes increase toughness damage taken by 5%.
ModMelodicPuzzle.flavor: Harmonious guardians offer protection, but a missed note can unleash chaos.

ModMelodicTune.description: HP +10% when rhythm timing window is perfect.
ModMelodicTune.curse_effect: Take double damage until next perfect timing.
ModMelodicTune.flavor: A melody of blessing and retribution dances through the air, weaving a symphony of challenge and reward.

ModMelodious.flavor: An ethereal melody either sharpens your musical accuracy or dulls your senses to the dangers around you.

ModMelodiousLabyrinth.curse_effect: Decreases ultimate gauge recharge rate by 10%.
ModMelodiousLabyrinth.flavor: In this room, the melody either grants perfect timing or saps your energy reserves.

ModMelodyMalediction.description: HP +10% within the next boss fight.
ModMelodyMalediction.curse_effect: SP -20% for the rest of your run, must use wisely!
ModMelodyMalediction.flavor: A serenade of sweet melodies and dark harmonies entwines your fate, a boon or bane depending on your ear for trouble.

ModMelodyMaze.curse_effect: Toughness damage +20%, ultimate gauge halves on fail.
ModMelodyMaze.flavor: Harmonic Heart soars with perfect notes, while Silent Sorrows whispers of failure in your soul.

ModMelodyMist.flavor: Dance through the notes, or risk running dry.

ModMidiMagic.flavor: When the music flows, so does your power; when it falters, beware the tune's curse.

ModMuseScore.curse_effect: Reduces ultimate gauge recharge speed by 15%
ModMuseScore.flavor: Marrying the melody brings harmony, but discord may shatter your power.

ModMusicalHarmony.curse_effect: Decrease ultimate gauge recharge rate by 10%
ModMusicalHarmony.flavor: A balance between harmony and discord enhances your musical prowess or leaves you with a sour note.

ModMusicNoteBlast.flavor: Beneath the sweet melody lies a hidden discord that can tear you apart if your rhythm is off.

ModMusicPulse.flavor: In this room, the air hums with a sweet, dissonant melody that strengthens your resolve but confounds your rhythm.

ModMysticHarmony.curse_effect: Decreases ultimate gauge charge rate by 20%
ModMysticHarmony.flavor: Benevolent notes strengthen your body, while discordant ones weaken your resolve.

SheetMusicChamber.description: HP +10% when within rhythm timing window
SheetMusicChamber.flavor: A room where off-key notes sap your resolve, while perfect harmony strengthens you.

SheetMusicHarmony.description: Increase ultimate gauge by 10% for every perfect note.
SheetMusicHarmony.curse_effect: Decrease speed by 20% for every missed note.
SheetMusicHarmony.flavor: Notes flow harmoniously, binding your fate with each strike on the keys.
